registry_snapshot_rule: first complete registry response after verified external timestamp
never_touched_rule: UCI integer ID and normalized title must both be absent from the existing-project ledger
table_rule: one tabular table; no temporal, grouped, image, text, graph, or multi-table task
license_rule: registry metadata must explicitly allow research use
key_rule: declared identifiers are retained only for hashing and never used as predictors
external_failure_rule: download, license, schema, parse, target, or compatibility failure remains in the registered denominator as EXTERNAL_FAIL
phase2_forbidden_until: external timestamp acknowledgement passes local hash verification
